purpose: CPU feasibility only; no relevance evaluation or fine tuning
selection: first 256 document IDs and 12 query IDs ordered by SHA256(ID); independent of relevance
query_augmentation: PAD replaced by MASK; attention mask unchanged; all 32 query vectors contribute
document_mask: PAD and first token ID of each ASCII punctuation symbol excluded
scoring: sum over query token vectors of maximum cosine similarity to retained document token vectors
timing: one warmup batch, one corpus encoding pass, three warm passes per query; separate query encoding, cached scoring all256 and first50; no network/model loading in latency
implementation: local uncompressed exact MaxSim prototype using official BERT+projection safetensors; not PLAID or residual-compressed official index; engine parity remains to verify
data_policy: read checksum-bound saved documents and query texts only; no qrels, quality scoring or modifications to original retrieval run
license: checkpoint card MIT, official ColBERT code MIT; SciFact/BEIR attribution retained in existing case; no new rights inferred for other datasets
